text:
What a fantastic experience with Dr Lilly. I came to get 3 implants, 2 crowns and teeth whitening. All achieved in 2 weeks and without a single bit of pain. I think I was a challenging patient as one of the crowns was on old root canal work.  Also colour matching the crowns with the rest of my teeth is a real art form and Dr Lilly's perfectionism meant she insisted the lab she uses had to remake the crowns to get the exact colour required.
Many thanks also to the implant surgeon who was superb.
All in all a great experience with a wonderful and highly skilled person.
I'll be back next time I need something done.

I recently visited Bangkok Dental Spa for a teeth whitening treatment, and I am beyond impressed with the results!

My teeth went from yellow to brilliantly white, and I couldn’t be happier with the outcome.

The whole process was smooth, comfortable, and surprisingly quick. Dr Lily was professional, attentive, and made sure I understood each step of the procedure.

If you’re looking for a dentist who truly cares about their patients and delivers amazing results, I highly recommend Dr Lily and their team!

I visited Dr Lily at the Bangkok Dental Spa in October to get started on two dental implants. I have experienced no issues with the previous work, and I had no pain at all with the current two - a major consideration, since I live in the US, and making an extra trip to correct problems would be difficult.

Dr Lily has been wonderful to work with, a complete professional. Our working relationship now spans at least 10 years. She has done four implants and a teeth whitening for me previously, and
has my absolute trust. Her prices are reasonable, and certainly way better than I could obtain in the US - plus I get to vacation in Thailand:)

Doctor Lily she is careful about everything related to patients health. Clinic is clean and surgeries are done very well. I didn’t feel any pain during the treatment. Best dentist you can have in Bangkok!

I recently visited Bangkok Dental Spa for a tooth whitening treatment. The experience was professional, efficient, and cost-effective. The entire procedure took around one hour, and the results were impressive—my teeth became noticeably whiter. The total cost was 150,000 THB, and I found it to be well worth the investment. The clinic is conveniently located near Soi Cowboy and close to popular tourist areas, making it easy to access.

The staff are highly experienced, with over 20 years of service in the dental industry.

I highly recommend Bangkok Dental Spa to anyone seeking dental services such as tooth cleaning, whitening, implants, or solutions for any dental issues. One area for improvement is that I experienced a slight burning sensation on my lips, which I assume was caused by the bleaching agent. It might be helpful if the clinic could find ways to minimize this discomfort in future treatments.

Whilst searching for a good dentist in Bangkok with good reviews, I came across Spa Dental Clinic. This turned out to be an absolute stroke of luck. Right from the first contact and initial consultation, I was convinced I’d found the right place. My problem was that my teeth were in a terrible state.
Dr Lilly said that my treatment would be her most challenging masterpiece.
Throughout my six-week treatment, I felt well looked after at all times, with a highly professional and top-class medical standard of care.
Over several sessions, teeth were extracted, posts were inserted into my jawbone, and finally the temporary restoration was fitted. Throughout the entire process, I only needed one painkiller, which speaks for itself.
I cannot thank Dr Lilly enough for her utterly professional and empathetic work. She offered me the entire treatment at a very fair price. In Germany, I would have paid many times more for the same treatment and would certainly not have received the service that was provided to me by the Spa Dental Clinic in Bangkok.
Now I can eat whatever I fancy again.
Thank you very much for that, and I can only recommend to everyone that they seek treatment here with Dr Lilly.
